order.received_confirm: Tsentmeḍ belli teṭṭfeḍ tuttra s lekmal-is, akken iwata? Axelleṣ ad yettwazen i {{supplier}}.
order.report_body: Idrimen ad qqimen ttwaḥebsen alamma teḥkem tarbaɛt n Saloneo. Amsewweq ad yettwaɛlem.

stock.title: Rnu ɣer uḥraz

apply.title: Zzenz i yisaluna n ccbaḥa n Lezzayer meṛṛa
apply.subtitle: Sken akatalug-ik n yimhenniyen i yisaluna n Saloneo. Kečč tettawiḍ, Saloneo teqbeḍ sakin tazen-ak-d.
apply.step1_body: Takebbanit-ik, NIF, RC d RIB. Asentem deg 48 n yisragen n uxeddim.
apply.step2_body: Afaris s ufaris neɣ s uktar n ufaylu CSV. Ssumat pro TTC, aḥraz, timnaḍin n wawway.
apply.step3_body: Asalun ixelleṣ s tkarḍa CIB / Edahabia. Kečč teqbleḍ, tazneḍ s uneqqal-ik, tefkeḍ uṭṭun n uḍfar.
apply.step4_body: Akken kan ara yesentem usalun tuṭṭfa (neɣ seld 7 n wussan), tasuqqilt ad tekcem ɣer usaḥ-ik u ad ak-d-tettwazen.
apply.fees: Ajerred d baṭel. Saloneo teṭṭef akmis ɣef yal tuttra yewwḍen (8 % s wudem amezwer), ulac ayen-nniḍen.
apply.payout_help: Amiḍan ɣer i d-tettazen Saloneo tasuqqilt n tuttriwin yewwḍen.
apply.accept: Ttaǧǧiɣ belli talɣut-a d tidet, qebleɣ ad teqbeḍ Saloneo axelleṣ n yisaluna ɣef yisem-iw sakin ad yi-t-tazen, akmis yettwakkes.
apply.email_taken: Yella yakan umiḍan s yimayl-a. Qqen.
apply.error: Asuter ur yettwazen ara. Ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen ticki.
